buttons.label: Idle
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') { actor.entity.enabled = 'TerraceIdle' === 'RoyalSit'; } const model = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (model?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { model.kingCapeWalkHandle?.off(); model.kingCapeWalkHandle = null; actor.entity.enabled = true; actor.entity.setLocalPosition(0, 2.3, 0); model.kingCapeYaw = 45; model.setLocalEulerAngles(0, 45, 0); model.anim.speed = 1; model.anim.baseLayer.play('TerraceIdle'); model.anim.baseLayer.activeStateCurrentTime = 0; } } camera.setViewport({zoom:5.2,rotation:0,panX:0,panZ:0});

buttons.label: Walk 1.5 m
buttons.script: let model; for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') actor.entity.enabled = false; const candidate = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (candidate?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { actor.entity.enabled = candidate.tags.has('king-review-TerraceWalk'); if (actor.entity.enabled) model = candidate; } } if (model) { model.kingCapeWalkHandle?.off(); model.kingCapeWalkDistance = 0; model.kingCapeYaw ??= 45; model.setLocalEulerAngles(0, model.kingCapeYaw, 0); model.anim.speed = 1; model.anim.baseLayer.play('TerraceWalk'); const app = model.anim.system.app; model.kingCapeWalkHandle = app.on('update', (dt) => { const distance = Math.min(Math.max(dt, 0), .05) * .45; model.parent.translate(-model.forward.x * distance, 0, -model.forward.z * distance); model.kingCapeWalkDistance += distance; if (model.kingCapeWalkDistance >= 1.5) { model.kingCapeWalkHandle.off(); model.kingCapeWalkHandle = null; model.anim.baseLayer.transition('TerraceIdle', .12); } }); if (!model.kingCapeWalkCleanup) { model.kingCapeWalkCleanup = true; model.once('destroy', () => model.kingCapeWalkHandle?.off()); } }

buttons.label: Turn left 90
buttons.script: let model; for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') actor.entity.enabled = false; const candidate = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (candidate?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { actor.entity.enabled = candidate.tags.has('king-review-TerraceWalk'); if (actor.entity.enabled) model = candidate; } } if (model) { model.kingCapeYaw = (model.kingCapeYaw ?? 45) + 90; model.setLocalEulerAngles(0, model.kingCapeYaw, 0); }

buttons.label: Turn right 90
buttons.script: let model; for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') actor.entity.enabled = false; const candidate = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (candidate?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { actor.entity.enabled = candidate.tags.has('king-review-TerraceWalk'); if (actor.entity.enabled) model = candidate; } } if (model) { model.kingCapeYaw = (model.kingCapeYaw ?? 45) + -90; model.setLocalEulerAngles(0, model.kingCapeYaw, 0); }

buttons.label: Stop and settle
buttons.script: let model; for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') actor.entity.enabled = false; const candidate = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (candidate?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { actor.entity.enabled = candidate.tags.has('king-review-TerraceWalk'); if (actor.entity.enabled) model = candidate; } } if (model) { model.kingCapeWalkHandle?.off(); model.kingCapeWalkHandle = null; model.anim.speed = 1; model.anim.baseLayer.transition('TerraceIdle', .12); }

buttons.label: Reset / back view
buttons.script: let model; for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'king-review-chair') actor.entity.enabled = false; const candidate = actor.entity?.findByTag('map-animation-actor')[0]; if (candidate?.tags.has('SeatedRoyal')) { actor.entity.enabled = candidate.tags.has('king-review-TerraceWalk'); if (actor.entity.enabled) model = candidate; } } if (model) { model.kingCapeWalkHandle?.off(); model.kingCapeWalkHandle = null; model.anim.speed = 1; model.anim.baseLayer.transition('TerraceIdle', .12); } if (model) { model.parent.setLocalPosition(0, 2.3, 0); model.kingCapeYaw = 45; model.setLocalEulerAngles(0, 45, 0); } camera.setViewport({zoom:5.2,rotation:2,panX:0,panZ:0});
